requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

outcomes.description: The original mug is relocated to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding another mug there while leaving the original mug behind.
outcomes.target: Compare the source mug with the edited image: the mug should be relocated to the headphones' right, with no original mug left at its source position.
outcomes.reference: Source image identifies the original blue mug on the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blue blurred remnant remains at that left position, while a separate white mug appears to the headphones' right.

checks.question: Is there sufficient visual evidence to identify the mug and headphones and compare their positions?
checks.complete_when: Both objects and their relative positions are clearly visible.
checks.partial_when: The objects are visible, but their relative positions cannot be determined confidently.
checks.absent_when: The image provides no usable evidence about the objects or their positions.
checks.unknown_when: The image is unavailable or otherwise insufficient to assess.

checks.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
checks.complete_when: The mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones.
checks.partial_when: There is visible progress toward placing the mug to the right, but it is not clearly to the right.
checks.absent_when: There is confident evidence that the mug has not been moved toward the right of the headphones.
checks.unknown_when: The relative positions or any progress cannot be determined confidently.

checks.question: Does the edited image show the original mug relocated to the right of the headphones, rather than an additional mug placed there while the original remains?
checks.complete_when: The original mug is clearly at the headphones' right and is no longer present at its source position; no evidence indicates it was duplicated.
checks.partial_when: There is visible progress toward relocating the original mug, but it remains at its source position or the relocation is otherwise incomplete.
checks.absent_when: The original mug remains at its source position and there is no visible progress relocating it; a separate mug at the right alone does not count as progress on moving the original.
checks.unknown_when: The source mug cannot be matched to the edited image, or the images do not provide enough evidence to determine whether it was relocated or duplicated.
